title: Incorrect default permissions in the agent configuration folder in Devolutions PowerShell Universal 2026.3.4 and…
description: Devolutions PowerShell Universal versions 2026.3.4 and earlier have incorrect default permissions on the agent configuration folder. This vulnerability allows a local unprivileged user to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by crafting a malicious agent configuration file that directs the agent to an attacker-controlled server.
